option_relations.rationale: Allergic fungal rhinosinusitis is a condition that causes nasal obstruction and discharge, but it is not directly related to the symptoms of abducens nerve palsy.
Transient left abducens (cranial nerve VI) nerve palsy is equivalent to Abducens Nerve Palsy, which is a direct match with the leaf label.
Chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps is a condition that causes nasal obstruction and discharge, but it is not directly related to the symptoms of abducens nerve palsy.
Iatrogenic Abducens Nerve Palsy is a subtype of Abducens Nerve Palsy, as it is a specific cause of the condition.
